purpose: Common diagnostic target/readout contract for LV/RV PV-loop morphology audits. This target pack defines measurement vocabulary only; it does not authorize model, solver, official case parameter, UI smoothing, or package script changes.

officialCaseSet.role: Canonical diagnostic subject ids for future morphology reports.

phaseSegmentation.scope: Per beat, per chamber, with identical label semantics for LV and RV.

labels.description: AV valve open, semilunar valve closed, ventricular volume generally increasing.
Late filling subset associated with atrial activation or atrial-pressure a wave, AV valve open, semilunar valve closed.
Both inlet and outlet valves closed, pressure rising, volume approximately constant before semilunar opening.
Semilunar valve open, AV valve closed, ventricular volume generally decreasing.
Both inlet and outlet valves closed, pressure falling, volume approximately constant after semilunar closing.
Samples within the configured event guard band around valve/phase boundaries or samples whose phase evidence is mixed.
Samples with missing, contradictory, or numerically non-finite evidence.

transitionReportingPolicy.summaryRequirement: Every primary morphology metric must report both transition-inclusive and transition-excluded-core values plus transitionSampleFraction.
transitionReportingPolicy.interpretationRule: If the qualitative conclusion changes when transition samples are excluded, report event-sensitive/sampling-sensitive and do not treat the metric as a stable morphology finding.

common.name: beatIndex
common.description: Beat identifier used for beat-aligned metrics.

common.name: dtSec
common.description: Local sample interval or explicit derivative denominator.

common.name: phaseLabel
common.description: Optional runner-supplied phase label; if absent, the future runner derives labels from valve and trajectory signals.

phaseCoverageFraction.description: Fraction of beat samples assigned to each phase label.

transitionSampleFraction.description: Fraction of beat samples labeled transition.

uncertainSampleFraction.description: Fraction of beat samples labeled uncertain.

pvLoopArea.description: Signed beat-aligned pressure-volume loop area using raw pressure and volume samples.

phaseNormalizedRoughness.description: Discrete curvature-like roughness within a phase, normalized by first-derivative variation plus epsilon. The future runner must record the exact formula and derivative stencil.

phaseKinkCount.description: Count of robust local slope or curvature outliers inside a phase.

samplingInvarianceDelta.description: Relative change in a metric across raw and configured resampling modes.

eventCorrelationWindowHitFraction.description: Fraction of morphology outlier samples that fall within the configured event/artifact correlation window.

lvRvAsymmetryIndex.description: Absolute LV/RV difference for the same metric, normalized by the chamber mean plus epsilon.

diagnostic-only.description: A report label, not an acceptance or rejection outcome.

stable-under-sampling.description: Metric interpretation is preserved across configured sampling modes.

sampling-sensitive.description: Metric magnitude or classification changes materially across configured sampling modes.

event-sensitive.description: Metric is dominated by transition or event-window samples.

lv-rv-asymmetric.description: The finding is materially different between LV and RV under the same method.

unclassified.description: Required evidence is missing or mixed.

raw.description: Use emitted samples without interpolation, preserving exact sample timing.

uniformBeatGrid.description: Beat-normalized uniform resampling for derivative sensitivity reporting only. The runner must record interpolation type.

eventAlignedCore.description: Event-aligned samples excluding transition guard windows.

coarseSensitivity.description: Downsampled or coarser beat grid used only to expose sampling-only artifacts.

guardrails.rule: This target pack must not be used to change model equations, solver behavior, official case parameters, package scripts, or UI display smoothing.
Raw-sample metrics are mandatory; resampled metrics are secondary sensitivity reports.
Primary morphology metrics must be reported both with and without transition samples.
LV and RV must use identical segmentation and metric definitions unless a missing-signal exception is recorded.
No single morphology metric in this pack is an official pass/fail target.
The future runner must record input artifact hashes and signal availability before computing metrics.

targetPolicy.interpretation: Completeness, reproducibility, and classification quality are the v1 targets. Official morphology acceptance remains out of scope.
